purpose: Durable per-execution causal evidence. Confirmations apply only to the identified full ledger; a future candidate requires revalidation. A diagnosis can explain a subset of failed assertions without explaining the entire execution.

entries.cause: Document.all is absent, so the incompatible receiver test passes undefined to the Window.name setter instead of an HTMLAllCollection.

assertion_names: Global object's setter throws when called on incompatible object (document.all)
evidence: docs/oryn2/CONFORMANCE-WINDOW-NAMED-FULL-2026-09-08.json
The 50993c3 generated Document interface has no all attribute; document.all evaluates to undefined.
Window.name correctly accepts an undefined receiver as the global object. The missing HTMLAllCollection prevents exercising the required incompatible-object check.

entries.cause: Parser script preparation lacks its required microtask checkpoint after removal of an unrelated Window named-property refresh.

evidence: docs/oryn2/CONFORMANCE-WINDOW-NAMED-FULL-2026-09-08.json
Commit 50993c3 removed host.execute(__oryn_refresh_window_named_properties()) from run_script_record. JavaScriptHost::execute previously drained microtasks after this refresh.

execute_parser_script queues pending observer notifications before script execution but drains them only after it. The pinned fixture needs parser insertions delivered before the next script and its disconnect call.
HTML parsing text insertion mode requires a microtask checkpoint at the script end tag: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#parsing-main-incdata
